Subject: POC trial RACI & next steps — Lakeside Health

Hi Priya / team — thanks again for the time today. Per our call, here’s a concise recap of the proposed POC success criteria, evaluation plan, timeline, and an initial RACI/stakeholder mapping so we can lock owners and next steps. Please read through and flag any changes by EOD Wednesday.

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood Inference can serve clinical summarization + triage models against a production-like subset of Lakeside patient messages with latency <= 300ms p50 and acceptable cost per 1k tokens.

Success criteria (minimum pass):
- Functional: model integration returns expected structured output for 90% of a 200-message test set (per your QA set).
- Latency: p50 <= 300ms, p95 <= 900ms for typical payloads (see test profile attached).
- Reliability: 99% request completion during test window.
- Security/compliance: network peering or VPC path validated; logs retained per Lakeside retention policy.

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed):
- Week 1 (Sep 27–Oct 1): infra provisioning & initial data slice ingestion; smoke tests.
- Week 2 (Oct 4–Oct 8): integration run with 200-message test set; collect metrics and qualitative evals.
- Week 3 (Oct 11–Oct 15): tuning, reruns, and final scorecard delivered.
- Goal: decision and next-step meeting by Oct 18.

Ownership / RACI (initial):
- Infra (VPC/peering, Dedicated/Private setup): Alex Martinez (Redwood) — Responsible; Lakeside infra (Samir) — Consulted; Marissa (Redwood) — Accountable for delivery timeline.
- App integration (API hooks, message mapping): Priya Choudhury (Lakeside) — Responsible; Alex (Redwood) — Consulted.
- Security & compliance review (network, logs, data flow): Samir Shah (Lakeside) — Responsible; Lauren Bishop (Redwood) — Consulted; Marissa — Accountable for coordinating evidence delivery.
- Procurement / contracting (SOW, MOA, paperwork): Jenna Morales (Lakeside) — Responsible; Marissa (Redwood) — Consulted.
- Product success criteria & sign-off: Dr. Elena Rivera (Lakeside) — Accountable; Priya — Responsible for acceptance tests.

Immediate next steps (action owners):
1) Alex (Redwood) to confirm infra provisioning ETA and provide the VPC/network checklist by Thu Sep 23.
2) Priya to share the 200-message QA set and any PII redaction rules by Wed Sep 22.
3) Jenna to confirm procurement timeline and PO requirements — target by Sep 24.
4) Marissa to circulate the MOA draft and invite the technical kick-off meeting for Sep 28.

Attachments: lakeside-poc-success-criteria.xlsx; redwood-moa-draft.pdf; lakeside-poc-raci.csv

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
